name: FY2013 PMMR Agency Performance Indicators
description:
This dataset contains performance indicators reported by New York City agencies as part of the Fiscal Year 2013 Preliminary Mayor's Management Report (PMMR). Each row represents a single measurement for an agency indicator, such as the share of Medicaid inquiries, food stamp assistance activity, or emergency assistance cases, along with the reporting period and geographic scope. The data spans fiscal years 2010 through 2014, with most records centered on 2012 and 2013.

Key fields identify the agency, indicator, and any sub-indicator, and describe how the result should be interpreted: the desired direction of change (for example, whether higher or lower is better), whether the indicator is flagged as critical, the geography covered (such as citywide), and the measure type. Results are stored in type-specific value columns—percentages, plain numbers, currency amounts, and times—with a raw value field and a format type indicating how each figure should be displayed.
